title: Band row

steps.text: Loop the band around a sturdy anchor at waist height, or around both feet while seated.
steps.cue: Anchor the band at waist height, or round your feet.

steps.text: Hold one end in each hand and sit or stand tall with your arms long.
steps.cue: Sit or stand tall, arms long.

steps.text: Pull both hands toward your ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
steps.cue: Pull to your ribs. Squeeze your shoulder blades.

steps.text: Pause for a breath, then return slowly.

mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears.
Letting the band snap back instead of returning slowly.
regression: Use a lighter band, or sit closer to the anchor.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your shoulders or lower back.

anatomy.why: The upper back draws the shoulder blades together while the arms bend to pull.

sources.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 11.5 Muscles of the pectoral girdle and upper limbs
